stories.title: Meta discussed ‘whisper strategy’ against social media critic Jonathan Haidt, files show
stories.summary: Meta employees discussed a “whisper strategy” to discredit social-media critic Jonathan Haidt, according to court documents. The files show staff considered encouraging the academic community to disavow the influential U.S. author, whose work has helped inspire restrictions on social media.

stories.title: ‘My social life completely plummeted’: gen Z is fighting back against big tech
stories.summary: Some Gen Z users are turning to distraction-blocking apps and stripped-down phones to reduce their dependence on major technology platforms. They say attention-driven social media services, including Instagram and TikTok, have harmed their social lives and profit from keeping them engaged.
